caption: The drawing depicts a corner of a room with beige walls and a brown wooden floor. On the left side, there is a partial view of a wooden door with a rectangular panel design, colored in various shades of orange-brown wood grain. To the right of this door, there is a narrow, vertically-oriented wooden cabinet or panel affixed to the wall, matching the door in color and style, with two visible hinges and a small round knob. The baseboard along the floor is also made of the same wood and color as the door and cabinet. Near the bottom right, below the cabinet and baseboard, there is a small black metal vent or register installed in the wall close to the floor. The image is bordered by a wide beige margin.
title: Shaker Cupboard
